metadata.title: Practical TypeScript Mastery for High-Velocity Product Development
metadata.description: A practitioner's roadmap to mastering TypeScript for day-to-day software delivery, focused on writing safer code faster, reducing debugging time, improving refactor confidence, and scaling codebases without type debt.

sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Core type system mental model and compiler configuration that every TypeScript developer must internalize.

sections.title: Type System Depth
sections.description: Advanced type modeling patterns, runtime validation, and generic programming for building expressive, safe type systems.

sections.title: Frontend Workflows
sections.description: TypeScript integration with React and frontend tooling for type-safe component development.

sections.title: Backend Workflows
sections.description: TypeScript patterns for Node.js APIs, databases, event systems, and end-to-end type sharing.

sections.title: Tooling and Operations
sections.description: Developer feedback loops, CI integration, editor ergonomics, and type-level testing.

sections.title: Scale, Migration, and Governance
sections.description: Refactoring at scale, performance engineering, modern feature adoption, and team practices.

nodes.title: Structural Typing
nodes.description: TypeScript determines type compatibility by shape, not name. Two types with the same structure are compatible.

nodes.title: Type Erasure and Runtime Behavior
nodes.description: All TypeScript types are removed at compilation. Types never affect runtime behavior.

nodes.title: Union and Intersection Types
nodes.description: Union types (A | B) model either/or values. Intersection types (A & B) combine type shapes.

nodes.title: Type Narrowing
nodes.description: Control flow analysis that refines broad types to specific types using type guards.

nodes.title: Discriminated Unions
nodes.description: Union members sharing a literal discriminant property for exhaustive type narrowing.

nodes.title: Literal Types and Inference
nodes.description: TypeScript infers exact literal values as types. Covers widening, narrowing, as const, contextual typing.

nodes.title: type vs interface
nodes.description: Choosing between type aliases and interface declarations based on use case, extension patterns, and readability.

nodes.title: any, unknown, and never
nodes.description: Understanding the top (any/unknown) and bottom (never) types. Avoiding any leakage, using unknown safely.

nodes.title: strict Mode and Safety Flags
nodes.description: The strict meta-flag and additional safety options: noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, etc.

nodes.title: Module Resolution
nodes.description: Choosing between NodeNext and bundler resolution. ESM/CJS interoperability. verbatimModuleSyntax.

nodes.title: Project References and Incremental Builds
nodes.description: Structuring monorepos with composite projects, tsc --build, and .tsbuildinfo caching.

nodes.title: TSConfig Layering Strategy
nodes.description: Designing multi-layer tsconfig inheritance for monorepos: base, package, test, and build configs.

nodes.title: State Modeling with Discriminated Unions
nodes.description: Modeling finite-state workflows, API responses, and domain states with discriminated unions.

nodes.title: Branded and Opaque Types
nodes.description: Creating nominally distinct types from structural primitives for IDs, units, and validated values.

nodes.title: Utility Types and Mapped Types
nodes.description: Built-in utility types (Pick, Omit, Partial, Readonly, Record) and custom mapped type patterns.

nodes.title: Conditional Types and infer
nodes.description: Type-level branching with extends. The infer keyword for extracting types from patterns.

nodes.title: Template Literal Types
nodes.description: Constructing string types from other literals. Route keys, event names, feature flags.

nodes.title: satisfies Operator and Type Readability
nodes.description: Using satisfies for validation without widening. Design principles for readable types.

nodes.title: Trust Boundaries and Parse Don't Validate
nodes.description: Identifying where compile-time safety ends and runtime validation begins. The parsing philosophy.

nodes.title: Type Guards and Assertion Functions
nodes.description: User-defined type predicates (value is Type) and assertion functions (asserts value is Type).

nodes.title: Schema Validation with Zod
nodes.description: Defining schemas, parsing data, inferring types, handling errors with Zod.

nodes.title: Schema-First vs Type-First Architecture
nodes.description: Choosing between deriving types from schemas vs schemas from types. Tradeoffs and tools.

nodes.title: Contract Testing
nodes.description: Ensuring API contracts hold across frontend/backend boundaries. Pact, OpenAPI, tRPC approaches.

nodes.title: Generic Fundamentals
nodes.description: Generic type parameters, constraints with extends, default parameters, and basic inference.

nodes.title: Generic Inference and Common Failures
nodes.description: How TypeScript infers generic arguments. Common inference failures and practical fixes.

nodes.title: Variance
nodes.description: Covariance, contravariance, invariance, bivariance. Explicit in/out annotations (TS 4.7+).

nodes.title: Generic Design Judgment
nodes.description: The Golden Rule, over-abstraction anti-patterns, when generics help vs hurt.

nodes.title: Generic Utility Patterns
nodes.description: Practical patterns: typed event emitters, generic repositories, builder patterns, constrained identity.

nodes.title: React Props Modeling
nodes.description: Typed props, optional props with defaults, children typing, extending HTML element props with ComponentProps.

nodes.title: Hooks and State Typing
nodes.description: Typing useState, useReducer with discriminated union actions, custom generic hooks.

nodes.title: Context API and State Management
nodes.description: Typed context creation, custom consumer hooks with null guards, reducer-based context.

nodes.title: Advanced Component Patterns
nodes.description: Generic components, polymorphic components (as prop), compound components, render props.

nodes.title: Event and Ref Typing
nodes.description: React synthetic event types, ref typing with useRef, forwardRef, useImperativeHandle, React 19 changes.

nodes.title: End-to-End API-to-UI Type Safety
nodes.description: Maintaining type safety from API through data layer to UI. tRPC, TanStack Query, Zod validation.

nodes.title: Typed Route Handlers
nodes.description: Express/Fastify/Hono typed request/response contracts using generics and type providers.

nodes.title: Middleware Augmentation
nodes.description: Extending framework types via declaration merging to add typed custom properties to requests.

nodes.title: Error Envelope Patterns
nodes.description: Standardized typed error responses. Custom error class hierarchies. RFC 9457 Problem Details.

nodes.title: Database Type Integration
nodes.description: Type-safe database access with Prisma and Drizzle ORM. Repository pattern. Drift control.

nodes.title: Typed Event Systems
nodes.description: Type-safe Node.js event emitters using event maps and generics. Versioned event contracts.

nodes.title: End-to-End Type Sharing
nodes.description: Sharing types between frontend and backend. tRPC, Hono RPC, shared packages, OpenAPI codegen.

nodes.title: tsc --noEmit and CI Type-Checking
nodes.description: Using TypeScript compiler as a type-checking gate in CI pipelines. Parallel stages.

nodes.title: typescript-eslint Typed Linting
nodes.description: ESLint rules using TypeScript type information. projectService, performance profiling, key typed rules.

nodes.title: VS Code TypeScript Mastery
nodes.description: Inlay hints, Go to Definition, Rename Symbol, Quick Fixes, diagnostics panel, workspace settings.

nodes.title: Type-Level Testing
nodes.description: Testing type behavior at compile time with expectTypeOf, tsd, and @ts-expect-error.

nodes.title: Type Coverage and Code Hygiene
nodes.description: Measuring type coverage with type-coverage. Dead code detection with Knip. CI thresholds.

nodes.title: CI Pipeline Design
nodes.description: Structuring CI workflows for TypeScript: parallel jobs, caching, monorepo optimization.

nodes.title: Testing Stack Integration
nodes.description: Type-safe testing with Vitest/Jest. Typed mocks, typed assertions, test tsconfig.

nodes.title: Incremental JS-to-TS Migration
nodes.description: Phased migration strategy: allowJs, checkJs, file-by-file conversion, strictness ratcheting.

nodes.title: Codemod Tools
nodes.description: Automated migration with ts-migrate, jscodeshift, and ts-morph. Writing custom codemods.

nodes.title: Type Debt Tracking and Burndown
nodes.description: Systematic any elimination: $TSFixMe patterns, type coverage CI gates, burndown metrics.

nodes.title: Monorepo Patterns and Boundaries
nodes.description: Structuring monorepos with project references, dependency boundaries, and ownership models.

nodes.title: Safe Large Refactoring
nodes.description: Strangler fig pattern, feature flags, contract tests as safety nets, compiler upgrade codemods.

nodes.title: Performance Diagnostics
nodes.description: Using --generateTrace, --extendedDiagnostics, and @typescript/analyze-trace to find bottlenecks.

nodes.title: Expensive Type Patterns
nodes.description: Patterns that slow type-checking: deep recursion, large unions, unconstrained generics. Mitigation strategies.

nodes.title: Emit Separation and Fast Builds
nodes.description: Decoupling transpilation (SWC/esbuild) from type-checking (tsc --noEmit). isolatedDeclarations.

nodes.title: Cache-Aware CI and Build Orchestration
nodes.description: Turborepo/Nx remote caching, affected-only builds, benchmarking methodology.

nodes.title: Modern TS Features (5.0-5.8)
nodes.description: High-impact features: decorators, const type params, using declarations, NoInfer, inferred type predicates.

nodes.title: Upgrade Playbook
nodes.description: Step-by-step process for upgrading TypeScript versions: canary branch, tooling sync, staged rollout.

nodes.title: TS 6.0 and 7.0 Preparation
nodes.description: Preparing for strict-by-default (TS 6.0) and the Go compiler rewrite (TS 7.0 Project Corsa).
